boundary_review.Proven_by: Real native responses and program observations, independent Codex acceptance, actual target Git commit, original finalize and final status
boundary_review.Consumed_by: Original qualification/artifact/outcome/ledger and delivery owners; final report only projects their facts
boundary_review.Enforced_before: Original contract/identity/scope/approval checks before dispatch and candidate acceptance; original delivery owner checks exact commit before COMMITTED
boundary_review.Failure_route: No automatic retry of unknown external actions; historical stops preserved; current no pending/unknown failure
boundary_review.Cannot_bypass_evidence: Existing operator refusal/threshold/observer tests plus real legal mainline. This sample did not newly execute every rejection/failure-prefix branch.
